authority: Expected complete diagnostic vectors authored from the unchanged AST producers and checked-in OXC span snapshots before execution. No lint output was used to capture or update expectations.

beforeBaseline.authority: beforeDiagnostics are source-derived legacy prefilter expectations, not execution receipts. Released-artifact observations must be retained separately.

contract.diagnostics: Every field of each diagnostic is asserted: rule_name, severity, message, start, end, help, labels, and fix. Empty arrays are full negative results.
contract.semanticBoundary: The current producers accept any own value-returning return; this corpus does not change control-flow analysis, the set of resolved APIs, or setter behavior.

cases.source:
<script lang="ts">
export default {
  computed: { total() { const value = 1 } },
  emits: { submit(payload) { void payload } }
}
</script>
cases.rationale: Ordinary computed getters and emits validators are FunctionExpression values whose body has no own value-returning return. OXC Function spans start at the parameter opening parenthesis, after the method key. Neither method has a legacy function needle.

diagnostics.message: Expected to return a value in this computed property.

labels.message: computed getter without a return value

cases.rationale: A block arrow remains a block arrow when a comment separates the arrow token from its opening brace. Neither producer sees an own value-returning return. The legacy needles reject both spellings.

cases.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
const total = computed({ get () { const value = 1 }, set (value) { void value } })
</script>
cases.rationale: Composition computed({ get, set }) resolves the getter even when whitespace separates get and (. The setter is not a getter and does not need a return. The legacy get( needle is absent.

cases.source:
<script lang="ts">
const café = "😀";
export default { computed: { total: { get /* read */ () { const value = 1 }, set (value) { void value } } } }
</script>
cases.rationale: Options API writable computed entries resolve a get method with comment trivia before (. The method span excludes the property key and comment. UTF-8 text and CRLF preceding it require byte offsets; the setter remains unreported.

cases.source:
<script lang="ts">
export default {
  computed: { total() { const helper = () =>	{ return 1 }; helper() } },
  emits: { submit(payload) { const helper = () =>	{ return true }; helper() } }
}
</script>
cases.rationale: The return finder skips nested arrow scopes. A return in each helper is not the outer computed getter or emits validator return. Tab trivia avoids accidentally admitting the old prefilter through the helper.

cases.source:
<script lang="ts">
export default {
  computed: { total() { return 1 } },
  emits: { submit(payload) { return !!payload } }
}
</script>
cases.rationale: Ordinary shorthand methods with their own return expression are valid. The wider prefilter must preserve the complete empty diagnostic result.

cases.source:
<script lang="ts">
const total = computed(() => 1)
export default { emits: { submit: (payload) => !!payload } }
</script>
cases.rationale: Composition computed and Options API emits concise-body arrows implicitly return their expression. The unchanged producers skip arrows with expression=true.

cases.source:
<script lang="ts">
export default {
  computed: { total: () => /* derive */
	{ return 1 } },
  emits: { submit: (payload) => /* validate */
	{ return !!payload } }
}
</script>
cases.rationale: Comment, newline, and tab trivia around a block arrow do not alter its own value-returning return. Both diagnostics remain absent after admission.

cases.source:
<script lang="ts">
export default { emits: { submit: null, cancel: null } }
</script>
cases.rationale: Null emits entries mean no validation. validator_from_value skips all non-function values, even though the wider brace prefilter admits the options object.
The array emits form contains no validators. resolve_emits_object returns None; widening the prefilter must retain an empty result.

cases.source:
<script lang="ts">
const total = useFoo(() => /* body */ { const value = 1 })
export default { methods: { submit(payload) { void payload } } }
</script>
cases.rationale: Unrelated calls and methods are outside both producer targets. There is no computed or emits token in the script, so the topic gate can still skip the block.

cases.source:
<script lang="ts">
const note = "computed emits"
const total = useFoo(() => /* body */ { const value = 1 })
export default { methods: { submit(payload) { void payload } } }
</script>
cases.rationale: Topic words in a string conservatively admit the script, but there is no computed getter or emits declaration. The AST producers retain the complete empty result.

cases.source:
<script lang="ts">
export default {
  computed: { total: () => { function helper() { return 1 }; helper() } },
  emits: { submit: function (payload) { void payload } }
}
</script>
cases.rationale: Known block-arrow and function-expression spellings already pass the old prefilter. The computed helper function return is in a nested scope and does not count as the getter return. These two complete diagnostics must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
